The FloPlast 110mm push-fit double socket bend is an essential component for redirecting soil and vent pipe systems. Manufactured from robust uPVC, this grey 92.5° bend offers strength and durability for drainage installations. Its lightweight design and push-fit system with reliable ring seal joints ensure swift and secure connections, making it ideal for both new builds and renovation projects. This double socket bend is suitable for high temperature waste discharges and provides a precise change of direction, simplifying complex pipework for plumbers and builders. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
